answer: The walnut of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The canyon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the garden. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
